tactical_watch.cadence: one every 14 days of the 4-week development block

weekly_rotation.name: Attack Trigger Map (MMA)
weekly_rotation.label: Tactical Focus
weekly_rotation.display_text:
Why: Build a library of the opponent's initiating cues before choosing any counter.
- Attack Trigger Map (MMA): 10 minutes, tactical review only. No physical load.
  Step 1: Find three attacks and rewind to the earliest repeatable movement before each one.
  Step 2: Separate cues for punches, kicks, entries and level changes.
  Step 3: Rank the cues by reliability and choose only the clearest for training.
  Intent: Read the start of the attack rather than reacting to impact.
  Focus: Lead-foot load, shoulder twitch, hand drop, level dip or stance switch that precedes offence.
  Reset: If the cue is ambiguous, keep the guard and angle away instead of guessing a counter.
  Anchor: Counter the launch, not the noise.
  Progress: Call the attack correctly from the cue in three fresh clips before progressing.

weekly_rotation.name: Safe Counter Range (MMA)
weekly_rotation.label: Tactical Focus
weekly_rotation.display_text:
Why: Distinguish counter range from the distance where a counter becomes a clinch or takedown risk.
- Safe Counter Range (MMA): 10 minutes, tactical review only. No physical load.
  Step 1: Pause examples at the moment the first attack enters range and mark both athletes' feet.
  Step 2: Decide which counters retain space and which invite immediate body contact.
  Step 3: Assign an exit or connection response to each range before reviewing the result.
  Intent: Counter only from a range that leaves a defendable second beat.
  Focus: The opponent's step depth and whether their hips or shoulders enter after the strike.
  Reset: If they crash through the counter line, frame, pummel or angle clear instead of admiring the shot.
  Anchor: Score with room for the next phase.
  Progress: Confirm in technical work that the counter leaves a reliable defensive second action.

blocks.purpose: Build whole-body ballistic power that shows in striking drives.

stop_rules: Stop if balance or control lost.

blocks.why_today: Short maximal jumps to transfer leg power into fight movement.
